name: Giant Spider

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.description: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is instead stable but Poisoned for 1 hour and Unconscious while Poisoned this way.

actions.name: Web
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 30/60 ft. Hit: The target has the Restrained condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10, 5 HP, vulnerable to Fire) or a creature takes an action to break it with a successful DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check. Recharge 5-6.

description: Giant spiders lurk in dense webbing strung between trees or cavern walls, waiting for vibrations to signal that something has blundered into their trap.
